properties.rule: zstd.h: every ZSTD_CCtx_* / ZSTD_compress*Ctx / streaming compression routine takes a context from ZSTD_createCCtx or ZSTD_createCStream (the two are the same type); ZSTD_freeCCtx / ZSTD_freeCStream release it. The harness keeps one CCtx. ZSTD_initStaticCCtx / ZSTD_initStaticCStream emplace one in a caller-owned workspace. The experimental entry points taking a CCtx (parameter structures, advanced initialisers, buffer-less and block-level compression, sequence compression, thread pool reference) need it as well.

properties.rule: zstd.h ZSTD_CCtx_refCDict Note 2: 'CDict is just referenced, its lifetime must outlive its usage within CCtx'. ZSTD_compress_usingCDict and ZSTD_getDictID_fromCDict / ZSTD_sizeof_CDict take the CDict directly. The harness keeps one CDict; a successful ZSTD_CCtx_refCDict makes the CCtx hold it until the reference is replaced (loadDictionary, refPrefix, another refCDict, ZSTD_initCStream, a parameter reset) or the CCtx is freed. ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary / ZSTD_CCtx_refPrefix drop the reference only when they succeed: inside a session they fail with stage_wrong and the CCtx keeps using the CDict. ZSTD_createCDict_byReference and ZSTD_initStaticCDict create a CDict too; ZSTD_initCStream_usingCDict(_advanced) reference it ('cdict will just be referenced, and must outlive compression session'), the other ZSTD_initCStream_* variants replace the reference when they succeed.

properties.rule: zstd.h advanced API: parameters 'can only be changed between 2 sessions'; a streaming session opens with the first ZSTD_compressStream/compressStream2/flushStream call and closes when ZSTD_endStream or compressStream2(ZSTD_e_end) returns 0, or on ZSTD_CCtx_reset / ZSTD_initCStream. Running a one-shot compression (ZSTD_compressCCtx, ZSTD_compress2, ZSTD_compress_usingDict, ZSTD_compress_usingCDict) on the same CCtx inside an open session re-initialises the context in unbuffered mode while the stream stage remains 'load'; the next streaming call dereferences a NULL input buffer (zstd_compress.c ZSTD_compressStream_generic). The same holds for the experimental entry points that re-initialise the context: ZSTD_compress_advanced, ZSTD_compress_usingCDict_advanced, ZSTD_compressSequences and every ZSTD_compressBegin* variant. The deprecated ZSTD_initCStream_* variants and ZSTD_resetCStream start with ZSTD_CCtx_reset(session_only) and therefore close the session. ZSTD_compressSequences opens a session too and returns without closing it (zstd_compress.c ZSTD_compressSequences: ZSTD_CCtx_init_compressStream2 sets the stream stage, nothing resets it), so after it the context needs ZSTD_CCtx_reset or a ZSTD_initCStream* before the next one-shot (repro.c case 4).

stream_call.meaning: a streaming compression routine is about to be called

oneshot.meaning: a one-shot compression on the CCtx is about to be called

session_end.meaning: the frame completed (endStream returned 0) or the session was reset

properties.rule: zstd.h ZSTD_CCtx_reset: resetting the session is 'useful after an error, or to interrupt any ongoing compression'. After a streaming compression call returns an error the context's buffers are inconsistent; continuing to stream without ZSTD_CCtx_reset or ZSTD_initCStream dereferences a NULL input buffer. The deprecated ZSTD_initCStream_* variants and ZSTD_resetCStream reset the session as well. ZSTD_compressSequences leaves the context inside a session that was not fed through the streaming buffers; the harness requires the same reset after it, whether it succeeded or not.

stream_fail.meaning: a streaming compression call returned an error, or ZSTD_compressSequences was called

stream_call.meaning: a streaming compression routine is about to be called

examples.reason: streaming continued on the session ZSTD_compressSequences left open

properties.rule: zstd.h ZSTD_initStatic*() Note 2: 'there is no corresponding "free" function. Since workspace is allocated externally, it must be freed externally too.' Limitation 1: a static context is 'currently not compatible with internal dictionary creation, triggered by ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary(), ZSTD_initCStream_usingDict() or ZSTD_initDStream_usingDict()'; the entry points listed here are the ones that do not reject a static context themselves and would leave a malloc'ed dictionary behind (zstd_compress.c ZSTD_initLocalDict, zstd_decompress.c ZSTD_DCtx_loadDictionary_advanced). The harness keeps a static object until the end of the run, when it releases the workspace.

properties.rule: zstd.h thread pool: 'Note that the lifetime of such pool must exist while being used. ZSTD_CCtx_refThreadPool assigns a thread pool to a context (use NULL argument value to use an internal thread pool).' The multi-threading context a CCtx creates on first use keeps the pool it was created with (zstd_compress.c ZSTD_CCtx_init_compressStream2: ZSTDMT_createCCtx_advanced(..., cctx->pool) only when cctx->mtctx == NULL), so a later ZSTD_CCtx_refThreadPool(cctx, NULL) does not release it: the pool has to outlive the CCtx (repro.c case 3). The harness keeps one pool and counts every successful ZSTD_CCtx_refThreadPool as a reference.

properties.rule: zstd.h buffer-less streaming compression: 'Start by initializing a context. Use ZSTD_compressBegin(), or ZSTD_compressBegin_usingDict() ... Then, consume your input using ZSTD_compressContinue() ... Finish a frame with ZSTD_compressEnd() ... ZSTD_CCtx object can be reused (ZSTD_compressBegin()) to compress again', and 'ZSTD_compressContinue() doesn't guarantee recover after a failed compression'. Block-level API: 'It is necessary to init context before starting + compression : any ZSTD_compressBegin*() variant'. ZSTD_copyCCtx duplicates a begun context. Any other compression, reset or initialisation of the CCtx ends the session. A session begun with ZSTD_compressBegin_usingCDict(_advanced) may search the CDict's tables in place, so the CDict must not be freed before the session ends.
